study_note: 6 full-training configurations comparing TD-AMBI reward-only versus entropy-augmented critics and fixed-temperature Q-normalized versus learned-temperature unnormalized actors. Each configuration runs one Humanoid Walk state trial with seed 55 and 2 million decisions. Full AMBI uses J6/N512/H3/B512, one paired update per batched imagined depth step, and replay capacity 9,216. Q-normalized families compare inner scale frozen per action versus updated per actor step. The entropy-augmented auto-temperature family learns inner alpha without temperature-gradient clipping; the reward-only auto-temperature family fixes inner alpha at the inherited outer value for each solve. All model checkpoints are retained every 25,000 decisions; separate final trial saves are disabled. Scaled-entropy targets are explicitly -441 wherever alpha is learned, with outer alpha initialized to 1e-4. For entropy-augmented critics, the bonus is alpha*S*H_scaled when Q scaling is enabled and alpha*H_scaled otherwise. Algorithm files specify the complete learner settings; no partial alg_params override is applied. This is a single-seed exploratory study. Each completed run produces 80 scheduled checkpoints.
